title: Is LOLA Migration Paving Path to OppFi's Long-term Success?
content:
OppFi OPFI is optimistic about the long-term scalability of the Loan Origination Lending Application (LOLA). The CEO stated that LOLA will serve as a clean architecture made to take advantage of swiftly developing AI tools in originations, servicing and corporate operations. The company plans to test it throughout the fourth quarter of 2025 and eventually migrate it in the first quarter of 2026.

One of the early success indicators of LOLA includes increased automated approval, which serves as the driving force behind OPFI’s top-line gains and margin expansion. In the third quarter of 2025, auto-approval rates increased to 79% year over year, which not only improved revenues but also reduced expenses by lowering human interaction. Therefore, an enhancement in the auto-approval will provide a significant bump in OPFI’s ability to improve credit quality.

Although the path to success might appear clear, the company might have to shoulder operational risks. The pivot to LOLA requires careful execution to mitigate disruptions. Despite the potential risks, the CEO is highly optimistic about OppFi’s ability to generate double-digit revenues and adjusted net income growth in 2026.

OppFi is known to cater to the population with high credit risks. Therefore, the combination of LOLA and Model 6.1 refit will improve precision to assess credit quality, improving loan volume. In the third quarter of 2025, OppFi registered a year-over-year decline of 490 basis points in the percentage of expenses to revenues, which can further improve post LOLA migration. Considering the successful implementation of this technology, we expect OPFI to maintain high margins, serving well in its future performance.

OPFI’s Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates

The OppFi stock has lost 9.1% in a year against the 11.9% fall in its industry. OPFI’s industry peer Global Payments GPN has declined 30%, while Cantaloupe CTLP has gained 33.6%.

title: OppFi Rallies 33% YTD: Should You Still Purchase the Stock?
content:
OppFi Inc. OPFI shares have gained 32.5% in the year-to-date period. It has surpassed the 11.6% decline of its industry and 19.8% growth of the Zacks S&P 500 Composite.

OPFI has outperformed its industry peers, Cantaloupe’s CTLP 11.2% rise and Fidelity National Information Services’ FIS 17.4% dip.

YTD Share Price PerformanceZacks Investment Research

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

The recent performance also shows that OppFi has outperformed Cantaloupe and Fidelity National Information Services. Over the past month, OPFI has gained 2.2%, beating Cantaloupe’s and Fidelity National Information Services’ 0.2% and 1.5% rallies, respectively.

Let us analyze further to conclude whether this stock is fit for an investor’s portfolio.

OppFi’s Operational Efficiency & Risk Management

OPFI utilized its proprietary AI and machine learning (ML)-based Model 6 to improve its auto approval rate to 79.1% in the third quarter of 2025 from the year-ago quarter’s 76.8%. This significant increment contributed toward the 500-basis-point (bps) year-over-year decline in total expenses as a percentage of revenues, which, when combined with a 13.5% year-over-year increase in the top line, led to a whopping 136.9% boost in net income. This disproportionate increase in revenues and profitability highlights OppFi’s operational efficiency.

Aside from strengthening the core business, Model 6 lowered the net charge-off as a percentage of total revenues by 430 basis points year over year for the nine months ending Sept. 30, 2025. Similarly, net charge-off as a percentage of average receivables decreased by 480 basis points for the same period. The significant decline in these metrics indicates improved loan quality, emphasizing OPFI’s success in risk mitigation.

Additionally, the company plans to introduce Model 6.1 refit in the upcoming quarters, which is expected to enhance its risk-mitigation capabilities.

OPFI Raises Guidance, Bolsters Investor Morale

OppFi has maintained its streak of hiking guidance for the full year in the third quarter of 2025 as well. In the fourth quarter of 2024, the company disclosed that it expects adjusted net income of $95-$97 million and an adjusted EPS of $1.06-$1.07 for 2025. Following that, it raised the outlook for adjusted net income to $106-$113 million, $125-$130 million and $137-$142 million in the first, second and third quarters of 2025, respectively.

On a similar note, the guidance for adjusted EPS was increased to $1.18-$1.26 in the first quarter and $1.39-$1.44 and $1.54-$1.6 in the second and third quarters of 2025, respectively. This trend reveals an obvious optimism among investors in the company’s profitability, which is a major green flag for investors.

Story Continues

OppFi Trades Discounted to the Industry

OPFI is priced at 5.99 times forward 12-month earnings per share, substantially below the industry average of 20.1 times. On a similar note, the company’s trailing 12-month EV-to-EBITDA ratio is 5.03 times, standing below the industry average of 10.94 times. These metrics validate OPFI’s undervaluation, appealing to value-based investors.Zacks Investment Research

Image Source: Zacks Investment ResearchZacks Investment Research

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

OPFI’s Promising Top & Bottom-Line Outlook

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for OPFI’s 2025 revenues is set at $598 million, indicating 13.6% year-over-year growth. For 2026, the top line is expected to grow 9.1%. The consensus estimate for OPFI’s 2025 earnings per share stands at $1.57, hinting at a 65.3% year-over-year increment. For 2026, the estimate is pegged at 8.6% growth.

Over the past 60 days, two EPS estimates for both 2025 and 2026 have been revised upward without downward adjustment. In the same period, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for 2025 earnings has risen 10.6%, and the estimate for 2026 has gained 15.5%, highlighting analyst confidence.

OppFi: A Must-Buy Stock

OPFI’s AI and ML-based Model 6 is the backbone behind improving the company’s core operations and lowering credit risk. These technological advancements led management to make consistent improvements in the profitability outlook for the full year across the past few quarters, boosting investors' morale. Moreover, the stock is fundamentally strong and undervalued when compared with its industry.

Banking on these factors, we recommend that investors add this stock to their portfolio to draw in significant capital gains in the long run.

OPFI flaunts a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) at present. You can see the complete list of today’s Zacks #1 Rank stocks here.

title: Is OppFi's Operational Efficiency Essential for Profitability?
content:
OppFi’s OPFI third-quarter 2025 performance is a testament to operational efficiency, driven by a combination of technological prowess and disciplined cost management, improving profitability. Starting with the top line, we found that the company posted solid 13.5% year-over-year growth, highlighting sustained customer demand.

This enriching growth in the top line was accompanied by a marginal hike in total expenses. However, a substantial decline in total expenses as a percentage of revenues was recorded, wherein the metric fell 500 basis points (bps) from the year-ago quarter. This striking improvement was facilitated by OppFi’s Model 6 and LOLA, raising auto-approval rates 230 bps from the year-ago quarter to 79.1%. Increased automation for loan decisions lowers the reliance on human underwriters, stripping away operational costs by a significant margin.

As expenses declined, OPFI witnessed an exponential growth in its profitability. In the third quarter of 2025, adjusted net income improved 41.4% year over year, and its margins expanded a whopping 500 bps. This robust growth is not a one-off event, but a prolonged trend evidenced by an 82.7% year-over-year upsurge in adjusted net income, translating to a 1,000 bps margin expansion in the nine months ended Sept. 30 of this year.

The disproportionality in OPFI’s revenues and adjusted net income growth demonstrates operational efficiency, essential while scaling the business, ensuring profitability sustainability in the long haul.

OppFi’s heavy reliance on technology optimizes its cost structure, creating an efficiency buffer that reduces the inherent credit default risk associated with its business structure. Management is heavily reliant on the company’s core technology, underscoring a heightened focus on operational efficiency. Motivations are apparent from the upward revision in adjusted net income to $137-$142 million for the year from that projected in the previous two quarters.

OPFI’s Price Performance, Valuation & Estimates

OppFi stock has risen 27.4% in the past year, significantly outperforming the 12.2% dip in its industry. The stock outperformed its industry peer Corpay’s CPAY 20.9% decline and Cantaloupe’s CTLP 17.1% growth during the same timeframe.

Leading CIOs honored for leadership, innovation, and business impact.2025 GeorgiaCIO ORBIE Award Winners

ATLANTA, Nov. 21, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The 2025 GeorgiaCIO ORBIE Awards recognized the exceptional leadership and innovation of top technology executives from Southern Company, AGCO Corporation, Equifax, Cox Enterprises, National DCP, Construction Resources, Cantaloupe (fmr), and Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport. The prestigious ORBIE Awards - hosted by GeorgiaCIO, a chapter of the Inspire Leadership Network - honor CIOs who drive business transformation and make a lasting impact on the industry.

Winners were recognized across eight categories: Super Global, Global, Large Enterprise, Enterprise, Large Corporate, Corporate, Public Sector, and Lifetime Achievement. The ceremony, which took place at The Hotel at Avalon, brought together top executives and industry leaders to celebrate excellence in technology leadership.

“Great CIOs understand how connections drive transformation,” said Elizabeth Hoemeke, GeorgiaCIO Chair. “The ORBIE® Awards recognize CIOs who leverage relationships to drive innovation, solve complex challenges, and shape the future of Georgia.”

Meet the 2025 GeorgiaCIO ORBIE Award Winners:

Martin Davis, EVP & CIO, Southern Company, received the Lifetime Achievement ORBIE.

Viren Shah, SVP & Chief Digital & Information Officer, AGCO Corporation, received the Super Global ORBIE for organizations over $6 billion annual revenue & multi-national operations.

Jamil Farshchi, CTO, Equifax, received the Global ORBIE for organizations over $1 billion annual revenue & multi-national operations.

Carolyn Pleiss, SVP & CIO, Cox Enterprises, received the Large Enterprise ORBIE for organizations over $8 billion annual revenue.

Chintan Patel, CIO, National DCP, received the Enterprise ORBIE for organizations over $2 billion annual revenue.

Scott Schemmel, CIO, Construction Resources, received the Large Corporate ORBIE for organizations over $600 million annual revenue.

Gaurav Singal, CTO (fmr), Cantaloupe, received the Corporate ORBIE for organizations up to $600 million annual revenue.

Chris Crist, CIO, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport, received the Public Sector ORBIE for government & public sector organizations.

The ORBIE is the preeminent executive recognition for C-suite leaders. Since 1998, the ORBIE Awards have recognized leadership excellence, building relationships between executives and trusted business partners, and inspiring the next generation of executives. content:
Company Logo

The United States Vending Machine Market is projected to grow from USD 21.9 billion in 2024 to USD 30.27 billion by 2033, at a 3.66% CAGR. This growth is driven by increasing demand in sectors like commercial, educational, and healthcare, and a shift toward convenient retail and technology integration. Modern vending machines cater to fast-paced lifestyles, offering diverse products from snacks to electronics, and support features like cashless payments and IoT-driven smart solutions. Despite challenges such as high investment costs and competition from e-commerce, continued innovation and strategic placement promise sustained market expansion.

U.S. Vending Machine MarketU.S. Vending Machine Market

Dublin, Nov. 10, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The "United States Vending Machine Market Report by Type, Technology, Payment Mode, Application, States and Company Analysis, 2025-2033" report has been added to  ResearchAndMarkets.com's offering.

The United States Vending Machine Market is expected to reach US$ 30.27 billion by 2033 from US$ 21.9 billion in 2024, with a CAGR of 3.66% from 2025 to 2033.

The market for vending machines in the US is anticipated to expand gradually due to expanding use in the commercial, educational, and healthcare sectors, as well as growing desire for easy retail solutions and technological integration. The U.S. vending machine market shows strong regional growth, with high adoption in urban centers, commercial districts, and educational institutions, supported by consumer convenience preferences, technological advancements, and expanding product offerings across multiple sectors.

The United States Vending Machine Market has experienced significant growth due to changing consumer lifestyles and the increasing need for convenience in food, beverages, and retail product distribution. Vending machines now offer a wide range of products, including snacks, beverages, personal care items, electronics, and even fresh food, catering to fast-paced urban lifestyles.

Technological advancements, such as cashless payment systems, touchscreens, and IoT-enabled smart vending solutions, have enhanced operational efficiency and customer experience. The integration of AI and data analytics allows operators to monitor inventory in real time, optimize product offerings, and tailor services based on consumer preferences. Additionally, rising health consciousness among consumers has encouraged the availability of healthy snacks, organic products, and low-calorie beverages in vending solutions.

Commercial establishments, educational institutions, hospitals, and transport hubs are major end-users driving the adoption of vending machines across the country. Retailers and service providers are increasingly investing in automated solutions to reduce labor costs, improve service efficiency, and expand their reach. The shift toward contactless transactions and hygienic food dispensing, accelerated by the pandemic, has strengthened demand for smart vending machines. Furthermore, operators are adopting eco-friendly machines with energy-efficient components and sustainable packaging options to align with environmental regulations and consumer expectations. Seasonal trends, location-specific consumer behavior, and urbanization are contributing factors shaping the competitive landscape of the U.S. vending machine industry.

However, the market faces challenges such as high initial investment costs, equipment maintenance, and security concerns. Technological integration requires consistent monitoring and updates, which can increase operational complexity. Additionally, competition from e-commerce, food delivery services, and convenience stores presents an alternative to traditional vending machines.

Story Continues

Despite these challenges, ongoing innovation, digital payment adoption, and strategic placement of machines in high-traffic locations are expected to sustain market growth. The U.S. vending machine industry is poised to evolve with advancements in smart technology, diversified product offerings, and consumer-driven solutions, ensuring long-term expansion across commercial and public sectors.

Key Factors Driving the United States Vending Machine Market Growth

Rising Demand for Convenience and Quick Access

The growing need for convenience is a major factor driving the United States vending machine market. Consumers increasingly prefer quick access to snacks, beverages, personal care products, and other essentials without visiting traditional retail stores. Busy lifestyles, longer working hours, and urban mobility trends have strengthened demand for automated retail solutions that are available 24/7. Vending machines located in offices, schools, hospitals, airports, and transit hubs provide round-the-clock accessibility, ensuring high footfall and consistent sales.

Additionally, the rise of impulse purchases and the appeal of immediate gratification contribute to higher machine utilization. Operators are leveraging prime locations, product variety, and promotional strategies to enhance revenue potential. The convenience factor, combined with increasing adoption of healthy and customized offerings, remains a significant growth driver for vending machines in the U.S. market.

Technological Advancements and Smart Vending Solutions

Technological innovation plays a crucial role in driving the United States vending machine market. The integration of cashless payment systems, mobile wallets, and contactless card transactions has significantly enhanced the user experience. Smart vending machines equipped with IoT sensors, remote monitoring, and AI-driven analytics enable operators to track inventory, analyze sales patterns, and optimize product selection in real time. Touchscreen interfaces, digital displays, and interactive features improve consumer engagement, promoting higher purchase rates.

Moreover, technological upgrades allow for seamless integration of promotional campaigns and personalized product recommendations, increasing customer loyalty. Smart vending solutions also support sustainability by monitoring energy consumption, reducing wastage, and implementing eco-friendly packaging. These innovations make vending machines more efficient, reliable, and attractive, strengthening their adoption across diverse end-use sectors.

Diversification of Product Offerings

The diversification of products available through vending machines is driving market growth in the United States. Modern machines offer a broad range of items, including snacks, beverages, fresh food, healthy options, personal care products, electronics, and even pharmaceutical items. Catering to evolving consumer preferences, operators are increasingly incorporating organic, low-calorie, and gluten-free products to meet the rising demand for health-conscious choices. Specialized vending solutions, such as refrigerated units for fresh food and beverage dispensing, have expanded the market reach.

Additionally, the ability to customize product offerings based on location, season, and consumer demographics enhances customer satisfaction. This diversification increases revenue opportunities for operators and ensures that vending machines remain relevant as automated retail solutions across multiple sectors.

Challenges in the United States Vending Machine Market

High Capital Investment and Operational Costs

A significant challenge in the United States vending machine market is the high initial investment and ongoing operational costs. Purchasing advanced vending machines with smart technology, touchscreens, refrigeration, and cashless payment systems requires substantial capital. Additionally, regular maintenance, inventory replenishment, and software updates contribute to operational expenses. Location acquisition costs, electricity usage, and potential equipment damage or theft further increase financial risk for operators.

Smaller businesses or startups may find it difficult to compete due to these cost barriers. Ensuring consistent machine uptime and managing supply chain logistics are also critical to sustaining profitability. Despite the revenue potential, the need for substantial upfront and recurring expenditure limits market entry and expansion for new operators, particularly in regions with lower footfall or reduced consumer spending capacity.

Competition from Alternative Retail Channels

The United States vending machine market faces intense competition from alternative retail channels, including convenience stores, supermarkets, e-commerce platforms, and food delivery services. Consumers increasingly opt for online ordering, home delivery, and subscription-based services, which provide broader product variety and convenience. Traditional vending machines may struggle to compete in areas where digital retail options are widely accessible.

Additionally, the limited physical space of vending machines restricts the quantity and range of products, impacting revenue potential. Operators must innovate through technology integration, diversified offerings, and strategic machine placement to remain competitive. Consumer preference for customizable, on-demand products and instant delivery options poses a challenge to the conventional vending model, requiring continuous adaptation to maintain market share in the dynamic U.S. retail ecosystem.

title: Sezzle Inc. (SEZL) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
content:
Sezzle Inc. (SEZL) came out with quarterly earnings of $0.71 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.65 per share. This compares to earnings of $0.49 per share a year ago. These figures are adjusted for non-recurring items.

This quarterly report represents an earnings surprise of +9.23%. A quarter ago, it was expected that this company would post earnings of $0.58 per share when it actually produced earnings of $0.69, delivering a surprise of +18.97%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has surpassed consensus EPS estimates four times.

Sezzle Inc., which belongs to the Zacks Financial Transaction Services industry, posted revenues of $116.8 million for the quarter ended September 2025, surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 12.38%. This compares to year-ago revenues of $69.96 million. The company has topped consensus revenue estimates four times over the last four quarters.

The sustainability of the stock's immediate price movement based on the recently-released numbers and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's commentary on the earnings call.

Sezzle Inc. shares have added about 44.2% since the beginning of the year versus the S&P 500's gain of 15.1%.

What's Next for Sezzle Inc.?

While Sezzle Inc. has outperformed the market so far this year, the question that comes to investors' minds is: what's next for the stock?

There are no easy answers to this key question, but one reliable measure that can help investors address this is the company's earnings outlook. Not only does this include current consensus earnings expectations for the coming quarter(s), but also how these expectations have changed lately.

Empirical research shows a strong correlation between near-term stock movements and trends in earnings estimate revisions. Investors can track such revisions by themselves or rely on a tried-and-tested rating tool like the Zacks Rank, which has an impressive track record of harnessing the power of earnings estimate revisions.

Ahead of this earnings release, the estimate revisions trend for Sezzle Inc. was mixed. While the magnitude and direction of estimate revisions could change following the company's just-released earnings report, the current status translates into a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for the stock. So, the shares are expected to perform in line with the market in the near future. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here.

It will be interesting to see how estimates for the coming quarters and the current fiscal year change in the days ahead. The current consensus EPS estimate is $0.91 on $134.54 million in revenues for the coming quarter and $3.27 on $442.08 million in revenues for the current fiscal year.

Story Continues

Investors should be mindful of the fact that the outlook for the industry can have a material impact on the performance of the stock as well. In terms of the Zacks Industry Rank, Financial Transaction Services is currently in the bottom 42% of the 250 plus Zacks industries. Our research shows that the top 50% of the Zacks-ranked industries outperform the bottom 50% by a factor of more than 2 to 1.

Another stock from the same industry, Cantaloupe (CTLP), has yet to report results for the quarter ended September 2025.

This electronic payment and wireless networking company is expected to post quarterly earnings of $0.08 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +100%. The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has remained unchanged over the last 30 days.

Cantaloupe's revenues are expected to be $81.45 million, up 15% from the year-ago quarter.
